description: This file defines the Snapshotter class used for capturing and managing page frame snapshots within the Playwright testing framework. It includes methods for starting, resetting, stopping, and capturing snapshots of browser frames, as well as handling frame hierarchy annotations.

classes.name: Snapshotter
classes.description: Manages capturing page frame snapshots, initializing snapshot scripts, and handling frame hierarchy annotations within a browser context.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the snapshotter, initializes scripts if needed, and begins snapshot capturing.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the snapshotter state in all frames.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the snapshotter from capturing further snapshots.

methods.name: resetForReuse
methods.description: Prepares the snapshotter for reuse by disposing of scripts and event listeners.

methods.name: _initialize
methods.description: Initializes the snapshotter by injecting scripts and setting up event listeners.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Removes event listeners and cleans up resources.

methods.name: _captureFrameSnapshot
methods.description: Captures a snapshot of a specific frame.

methods.name: captureSnapshot
methods.description: Captures snapshots of all frames in a page and delegates the snapshot data.

methods.name: _onPage
methods.description: Handles new page events to annotate frame hierarchy.

methods.name: _annotateFrameHierarchy
methods.description: Annotates the frame hierarchy for a given frame to include frame IDs.
